held_list.headline: Because of AI, 52% of students with elevated depressive symptoms who used a generative-AI coaching app for six weeks improved meaningfully, against 32% given care as usual.
Because of AI, Oman screened 43,000 diabetics for retinopathy, flagged 12,000 for treatment, and cut specialist waiting lists by 87%.

Because of AI, specialist consultations at two hospitals in western China took 3.14 minutes instead of 4.41 when patients first gave their history to a chatbot, and patients rated communication easier.
held_list.detail: evidence: drafter A, verifier could not grade.

leads_added: AI-facilitated individualized nutritional guidance after GI cancer surgery, single-centre RCT (n=90, DeepSeek v3.2 plus dietitian review vs handout). [Support Care Cancer](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00520-026-11401-7) (2026-10-29). Read in full via Europe PMC. Energy adequacy 66.7% vs 40.0% (OR 3.0), protein 62.2% vs 35.6%; no difference in weight, labs or complications. Not drafted: the paper says it cannot isolate AI from individualization and quantified targets, the enrolment window is January to March 2026 in Methods but December 2025 to February 2026 in Results, and the complication rate differs between text and Fig. 2. Missing: a consistent achieved window.

AI rainfall-onset forecasts for Ethiopian smallholder farmers, 64-woreda cluster RCT. [AEARCTR-0020000](https://www.socialscienceregistry.org/trials/20000) (ongoing, intervention 2026-06-01 to 2026-07-19). A registration, no results. Missing: a results paper with planting and input outcomes.

AI-generated draft response tool, message turnaround and after-hours replies. [JAMA Netw Open](https://doi.org/10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2026.41364) (2026-10-01). Real deployment. Compare ucla-chart-summarizer-rct. Missing: the primary read (HTTP 403; try Europe PMC), design, dates, absolute minutes.

Does AI-powered clinical documentation enhance clinician efficiency? Longitudinal study. [NEJM AI](https://ai.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/AIx2601335) (2026-10-23). Compare ambient-scribes-nejm-ai. Missing: the primary read, comparison, dates, absolute numbers.

Carried over, still unread: Annals scribe deployment study ([doi](https://doi.org/10.7326/ANNALS-25-05294)), AI-triggered rapid response and mortality ([NEJM AI](https://doi.org/10.1056/AIoa2500973)).

Protocols to watch: [AEARCTR-0020087](https://www.socialscienceregistry.org/trials/20087) (AI tutoring for young people with disabilities, Cali, from 2027-03), [AEARCTR-0019133](https://www.socialscienceregistry.org/trials/19133) (Chat2Learn-AI parenting RCT).
